public.text: The principle calls for representation with genuine weight but does not define how participation influences decisions. Representation without voting rights, agenda-setting power, accessible materials, or feedback obligations may remain symbolic.
public.suggestedRevision: Require governance terms of reference to define nomination, voting or decision rights, quorum, agenda-setting, accessible participation, compensation where appropriate, publication of responses, and mechanisms showing how stakeholder input affected decisions.
